recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-14786 unless a human separately wants to revisit the later editorial phrasing.
issue_request: FHIR-14786 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 technical correction for FHIR-core profiling section 5.1.0.3.2. It asked to remove the accidental word "one" from "These profiles represent different use cases leading to handling the one resources differently" so the text would read "handling the resources differently."
initial_application: The Jira comment says the typo was fixed under a different line item. Git history shows the bad wording was introduced by 93dab2524d9b2c60e8b1d4c93448d3c34fb07226 and corrected by f5bec5b522a49c64786a924737973c1c7dc34111 (#14785 - fix typo), which changed the sentence to the Jira-requested wording on 2018-02-10.
additional_context: The active profiling narrative is source/profiling.html, linked from source/documentation.html and many core narrative pages. A later typo/refinement commit, ae98cd7917c5ccc33cb42bddfad558a897b81196 (GF#14522 - fix typo), changed the same sentence to refer explicitly to CapabilityStatement.rest.resource.type while preserving the removal of the accidental word. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community record.
reconciliation: No source file was changed. The obsolete wording is absent from current source, and source/profiling.html:165 now says the profiles lead to handling resources of the indicated CapabilityStatement.rest.resource.type differently.

related_jiras.note: The Jira comment and git history indicate the typo was fixed under this neighboring line item.
